data.narrative:
Eclipse Space is a seed-stage Space & Aerospace company founded by Derek Huerta (former SpaceX senior manager of satellite payload engineering) and Kyle Leveque (ex-Astro Digital/Aquila Space). The valuation universe comprises 5 public comps (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) trading at a sector P/S median of 24.4x, and 8 private peers including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, ICEYE, and Sierra Space.

Standard triangulation methods face material constraints here. Peer-Median analysis is inapplicable: while 14 same-sector seed/early-stage private companies exist, only 1 matches Eclipse's exact stage with no adjacent-stage or similar-tier datapoints available, falling below the three-datapoint minimum needed for robust comparison. Public-Comp Anchoring cannot be deployed because Eclipse's revenue remains undisclosed, a standard limitation for private companies. Without revenue figures, applying the 24.4x sector multiple yields no actionable result.

This analysis cannot produce a triangulated valuation range given current data constraints. A defensible valuation would require either: (i) disclosure of Eclipse's revenue run-rate or forward projections, enabling public-comp multiples application; (ii) access to transaction details or post-money valuations from the 1–2 closest seed-stage Space & Aerospace peers; or (iii) founder equity history and dilution assumptions if prior rounds are documented. The founder pedigree (SpaceX operations background) and peer-to-tier positioning relative to top-5 private space companies warrant further due diligence but do not substitute for quantitative anchors.
